witness.quote: A driver may drive across a pavement striping marking such zone to an adjoining highway if the driver has first given the appropriate turn signal and there will be no impediment to oncoming or following traffic.
witness.reason: The fixed road-entry task can cross zone-marking striping to an adjoining highway; generic striping alone does not establish that zone.
required_context: Establish highway status, qualifying vehicle and driver actual physical control.
Establish qualifying highway and driver/vehicle status.
Establish that the destination is an adjoining highway rather than assuming a private driveway qualifies.

Preserve unresolved zone-establishment provisions, subsections 3 and 4, and the meaning of “appropriate” and “impediment”; do not import the left-turn branch's express NRS 484B.413 reference into this branch.
Realize the intersection, adjoining-highway entry route and pavement striping's actual zone-marking function, designation, extent and relationship to the route.
Record signal form and activation before crossing and oncoming/following traffic throughout the contemplated maneuver.
Retain signal form and activation before crossing, crossing trajectory, and oncoming and following traffic before, during and after the maneuver.
Retain unresolved zone-establishment provisions, exceptions and signaling requirements; do not infer permission.
Supply zone designation, boundaries, full marking length and the striping's zone-marking function without treating signage as an independently stated prerequisite.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver can physically control a qualifying vehicle; destination highway status must be established independently.
